two_step.title: 2-step sign-in
two_step.body: Add a code from an authenticator app (like Google Authenticator or 1Password) when you sign in, so a stolen password alone can't open your classes.
two_step.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
two_step.qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
two_step.manual: Can't scan it? Enter this key instead:
two_step.enter_code: Then type the 6-digit code the app shows.
two_step.disable_prompt: To turn it off, type a current 6-digit code from your app.
two_step.done_on: 2-step sign-in is on. You'll be asked for a code each time you sign in.
two_step.gate_body: This account uses 2-step sign-in. Type the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

errors.wrong_code: That code didn't work. Check the time on your device and try the newest code.
